notes: Grim Chess assessment benchmarks. Rating scale 'GR' = FIDE Standard (post-1-Mar-2024) for >=1400; below 1400 an extended logistic scale with NO FIDE equivalent. All band values are PRIORS assembled from heterogeneous sources (status='prior'); replace with platform-measured values from the calibration study in knowledge-base/04-assessment/10-benchmarks-by-rating-band.md section 5 before showing them to users as typical values. ACPL in centipawns (live moves, per-move cap 400cp per Grim-ACPL v1); accuracy = Lichess production formula, online rapid; blunder = drop >= 0.3 winning chances (~150-170cp from equality) on a live move, per player per game. percentileFide = % of FIDE-listed players (all listed, Oct 2026 list) below the rating; null below the floor. Index: knowledge-base/04-assessment/README.md.

scale.name: GR (Grim Rating)
scale.belowFloorLabel: Grim Rating (extended scale; no FIDE equivalent)
scale.pre2024FideRemap: R_new = R_old + 0.4*(2000 - R_old) for 1000 <= R_old < 2000 (one-off FIDE adjustment, 1 Mar 2024)

titles.name: Grandmaster
titles.requirements: FIDE rating >= 2500 at any time plus GM norms totalling >= 27 games (each norm >= 9 games, Rp >= 2600, avg opp >= 2380, >= 1/3 (min 3) GM opponents, >= 50% titled opponents, >= 2 foreign federations, score >= 35%); or direct title from listed events. Requires FIDE-rated OTB play.

titles.name: International Master
titles.requirements: FIDE rating >= 2400 plus IM norms totalling >= 27 games (Rp >= 2450, avg opp >= 2230, >= 1/3 (min 3) IM/GM opponents, >= 50% titled, score >= 35%); or direct title.

titles.name: FIDE Master
titles.requirements: FIDE rating >= 2300 based on >= 30 rated games (no norms); or direct title.

titles.name: Candidate Master
titles.requirements: FIDE rating >= 2200 based on >= 30 rated games (no norms); or direct title.

titles.name: Woman Grandmaster
titles.requirements: FIDE rating >= 2300 plus WGM norms totalling >= 27 games (Rp >= 2400, avg opp >= 2180, >= 1/3 (min 3) WGM/IM/GM opponents, score >= 35%); or direct title.

titles.name: Woman International Master
titles.requirements: FIDE rating >= 2200 plus WIM norms totalling >= 27 games (Rp >= 2250, avg opp >= 2030, >= 1/3 (min 3) WIM/WGM/IM/GM opponents, score >= 35%); or direct title.

titles.name: Woman FIDE Master
titles.requirements: FIDE rating >= 2100 based on >= 30 rated games; or direct title.

titles.name: Woman Candidate Master
titles.requirements: FIDE rating >= 2000 based on >= 30 rated games; or direct title.

platformMilestones.rule: Award '<TITLE>-equivalent strength (estimated)' when GRhat - 1.2816*SE >= minRating at two evaluations >= 30 days apart, SE <= 100, >= 30 rated standard-TC games in last 180 days, game-signal estimate >= minRating - 50, consistency test p >= 0.01, knowledge gates passed. Never display bare title abbreviations; never claim FIDE titles or norms.

lichessToFide.description: Lichess CLASSICAL rating -> FIDE Standard (post-2024), lower bounds of ChessDojo cohorts (Sep 2024). Piecewise-linear interpolation; return null below the first point (FIDE floor) and above the last point (unreliable). Treat as a prior with sd ~200. Not valid for blitz/bullet.

alternatives.name: Lichess blitz regression (self-reported FIDE, n=1606, era unknown)

chesscomToFide.description: Chess.com RAPID rating -> FIDE Standard (post-2024), ChessDojo cohort lower bounds (Sep 2024). Same interpolation rules.

lichessPuzzleToFide.description: HEURISTIC Lichess puzzle rating -> FIDE-equivalent (GR). Inverse of band puzzleRating priors. Low evidence; use only as a weak prior (sd 300). Replace with a platform-fitted mapping.
lichessPuzzleToFide.source: Heuristic informed by https://lichess.org/forum/general-chess-discussion/data-analysis-lichess-vs-fide-ratings (n=230, median puzzle-FIDE gap 81) and Lichess puzzle/blitz correlation r~0.8-0.85; see knowledge-base/04-assessment/04-rating-conversions.md

fideToUschess.description: Official US Chess initialization formula (corrected 2025, retroactive to 1 Mar 2024)

accuracyFormula.winPercentNotes: cp from the mover's perspective; clamp cp to [-1000, 1000] first (scalachess CEILING); mate -> +/-1000. Source stores MULTIPLIER = -0.00368208 and computes exp(MULTIPLIER*cp): equivalent, do not double-negate.
accuracyFormula.moveAccuracyNotes: The public Lichess page formula (moveAccuracy) omits the +1 'uncertainty bonus' present in production code (lila AccuracyPercent.scala). Grim-Accuracy v1 uses moveAccuracyProduction.
accuracyFormula.gameAccuracy: windowSize = clamp((nPositions-1)/10, 2, 8); window weight = clamp(stdev(winPercent in window), 0.5, 12); gameAccuracy = (volatilityWeightedMean(moveAcc) + harmonicMean(moveAcc)) / 2

reganAsdLine.source: Regan CSE702 S25 ASD line (SF16, FIDE OTB): https://cse.buffalo.edu/~regan/ChessSeminar/CSE702EloEvolution.pdf

reganIpr2012.warning: Do not apply to Stockfish output.

stockfish.calibration: Since PR #4341 (merged 23 Jan 2023; Stockfish 16+): UCI_Elo -> Skill via cubic fit of games between Stockfish master at Skill 0-19 and Stash engine versions rated on CCRL; TC 120+1, 8moves_v3.pgn; anchored to CCRL Blitz to within +/-100 Elo. Engine-pool scale, NOT calibrated against humans. The pre-2023 calibration (PR #2225: 60+0.6, anchored to goldfish1.13 ~ CCRL 40/4 2000) is obsolete.
stockfish.skillLevelEloNotes: Levels 0-18: numerical inverse of the source polynomial (CCRL Blitz scale). Level 19: measured ~3191 in the PR #4341 table (polynomial reaches only ~18.38 at 3190). Level 20 = unrestricted; no meaningful Elo vs humans.

kFactors.condition: new player until 30 games; or until end of year of 18th birthday while < 2300

fide.fourHundredRule: difference capped at 400 for players < 2650; full difference for >= 2650 (from 1 Oct 2025)

percentiles.source: Rama Chess count of Oct-2026 FIDE list: https://ramachess.com/articles/what-is-a-good-chess-rating/

actBenchmarks.note: Dutch ratings, 1998, N=215; not directly transferable to post-2024 FIDE.

assessment.bratkoKopecNote: Kopec, Newborn & Yu (1986) table; authors disclaim absolute validity; not for platform rating use. https://www.sci.brooklyn.cuny.edu/~kopec/Publications/THE%20BRATKO-KOPEC%20TEST%20RECALIBRATED.htm
